A Contemporary Fresnaye Family Home

Prime corner position | Elevated north-east aspect | R41 500 000

Set high on a coveted corner site in Fresnaye, one of Cape Town's most prestigious Atlantic Seaboard addresses, this exceptional modern residence delivers a rare blend of architectural confidence, privacy and effortless family living.

North-east facing and beautifully positioned to capture natural light throughout the day, the home is bright, calm and expansive — a sophisticated urban sanctuary designed for discerning buyers who value both style and substance.

Inside, clean contemporary lines are softened by warm, inviting interiors and dramatic architectural details. Full-height glass doors dissolve the boundary between indoors and out, opening the living spaces onto a generous private pool deck and lush garden — ideal for grand-scale entertaining, relaxed weekends and seamless day-to-day living.

The ground level is designed around connection and ease, with an open-plan living and dining area, a chef's kitchen, separate scullery, executive home office and a guest suite or fourth bedroom. Every space has been considered for flow, comfort and functionality.

Upstairs, the private family level offers a cosy pyjama lounge, a magnificent main suite and two additional bedroom suites, creating a quiet retreat above the entertainment areas below.

The versatile lower level adds another layer of lifestyle value, with a gym or playroom, wine cellar, laundry, staff suite, multiple garaging and additional secure parking.

Elevator access connects all levels with ease, while top-tier security, solar power and inverter installations ensure modern resilience, convenience and peace of mind.

A home of presence, polish and possibility — crafted for luxurious entertaining, elevated family living and the rare privilege of owning in one of Cape Town's most exclusive enclaves.
